module_summary: Dynamic stream fork: masks a child cc_stream_fork's outputs with a handshaked selection mask, auto-acknowledging unselected outputs and gating input on sel_valid_i.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input stream valid, forwarded to the fork only while the selection is valid.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Input stream ready, driven by fork input ready when sel_valid_i is set.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Per-output valid, passing fork valid only for outputs selected in sel_i.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Per-output ready, forwarded to the fork for selected outputs.

anchors.name: sel_i
anchors.why: Output selection mask deciding which outputs see the handshake.

anchors.name: sel_valid_i
anchors.why: Selection mask valid; gates input and output handshakes.

anchors.name: sel_ready_o
anchors.why: Selection mask ready, consumed together with the input transfer.

anchors.name: int_oup_ready
anchors.why: Ready to fork outputs; forced high for unselected outputs.

anchors.name: int_inp_valid
anchors.why: Gated input valid into the child fork.

groups.name: input_gating
groups.description: Gates input valid/ready and selection handshake on sel_valid_i.

groups.name: output_masking
groups.description: Per-output masking of fork valid/ready by sel_i; unselected outputs auto-ready.

groups.name: fork_core
groups.description: Child stream fork with input and per-output FSMs.
